participation.context: Read the line and did not go to the Bell.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw where the carrier was listed. You left the lodging for the Theatre later, not for the Bell.

title: Did not go to the Bell

participation.context: Reported the line once and paid threepence.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Refused a play she had not seen and took the threepence.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked whether the pie was a word or a thing, and got both answers kept apart.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: she rules on a report, not on a play she attended

story.body: You told them the yard's noise in one line and ate the house's supper. You did not bring the wage book to the table.

relations.note: she rules on a report, not on a play she attended

title: Reported the cook and paid for supper

description: Four lines, and not the brook

participation.context: Wrote four plain lines and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Was not in the room. The lines were addressed to her and not answered by her.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote four lines. You said the chamber was still yours and that you were well. You gave her nothing of the day. You said Gilbert had agreed to fetch what the carrier left, and you named no fee. You did not improve the answer from the fifth.

title: Wrote four lines home
